ValidationRule.description: The shipping address is required for new ISP accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Independent_Service_Provider", ISNEW(), OR( ISBLANK(ShippingStreet) || ISBLANK(ShippingCity) || ISBLANK(ShippingState) || ISBLANK(ShippingPostalCode) || ISBLANK(ShippingCountry) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A valid shipping address is required.
